name: jotaid
title: Jotaid
description: Search your Jotaid notes and send anything you are reading straight to the Inbox.
author: leeron

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.subtitle: Jotaid
commands.description: Search your notes by title or content and open them in Jotaid.

commands.name: create-note
commands.title: Create Note
commands.subtitle: Jotaid
commands.description: Write a note and file it in your Jotaid Inbox.

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Quick Capture
commands.subtitle: Jotaid
commands.description: Send the selected text — or the clipboard — to your Jotaid Inbox without leaving the app you are in.

preferences.name: searchContent
preferences.title: Search
preferences.label: Search note content
preferences.description: Match the body of a note as well as its title. Turn off to match titles only, which is faster on large libraries.

preferences.name: showPreview
preferences.title: List
preferences.label: Show preview in list
preferences.description: Render the note next to the list. Turn off for a denser list without the preview pane.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
